episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses strategies for leveraging past clients and existing properties to generate new business. He covers the benefits of converting primary residences into rental properties, using bridge loans to eliminate contingencies, and tapping into home equity with HELOCs. The episode also explores how AI is streamlining the loan process, offering practical insights for real estate agents looking to expand their offerings.
